clips.title: The story
paras: Ravenholdt Manor watches over Hillsbrad from high in the mountains. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt leads its guild of thieves and assassins, where practitioners of stealth hone their craft beyond the authorities’ reach.

Northwest of Durnholde Keep, a narrow pass and winding cave lead to Ravenholdt Manor. The estate stands isolated on the borderlands of the Alterac Mountains, and belongs to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt. He keeps a disciplined enclave of rogues, assassins, and intelligence operatives. A tranquil garden and outdoor training arena give them space to practice lockpicking, poison-crafting, and close-quarters combat under martial experts like Master Kang. Those with a talent for skullduggery are welcome, but watchful sentries greet clumsy outsiders and unwanted visitors with cold suspicion.

Before the First War, the land around Ravenholdt Manor belonged to the kingdom of Alterac, a past recalled by the manor’s weathered orange roof tiles. After Alterac fell, its displaced nobles in the Syndicate sought control of the region, bringing them into conflict with Ravenholdt. Jorach’s followers fight across Hillsbrad and Alterac to preserve their sovereign haven.
